lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular horizontal grid posterior to the branchial region, with higher spatial density along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the primary flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature on the upper third of the flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and deep shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance circular blobs located within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated near the leading edge and base.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of minute, high-luminance pixel points is visible on the cephalic region, anterior to the first gill slit, distinct from the larger flank patterning.
